scripts.dev: sh ./scripts/with-worktree-env.sh sh -c 'electrobun prepare && vite build && bun run build:cli && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "electrobun dev --watch"'
scripts.dev:desktop: sh ./scripts/with-worktree-env.sh sh -c 'electrobun prepare && vite build && bun run build:cli && electrobun dev --watch'
scripts.build: sh ./scripts/with-worktree-env.sh sh -c 'electrobun prepare && vite build && bun run build:cli && electrobun build --env=canary'
scripts.build:release: DASH_BORED_RELEASE=1 sh ./scripts/with-worktree-env.sh sh -c 'electrobun prepare && vite build && bun run build:cli && electrobun build --env=canary && bun ./scripts/repair-macos-release-artifacts.ts'
scripts.qa:fast: sh ./scripts/with-worktree-env.sh sh -c 'tsc --noEmit && bun test && vite build && bun run build:cli'
scripts.qa: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build:renderer && bun run build:cli
